concept.hr: Svaki odjel ima svoje: tuđi popravak pokvari ono što se ne vidi
concept.en: Each department owns its things: an outsider's fix breaks what they can't see

summary.hr: Dvanaest malih problema na setu: daj svaki odjelu ili 1st AD-u, ili ga riješi na svoju ruku, i vidi što slijedi: popravak, greška kontinuiteta, opeklina.
summary.en: Twelve small problems on set: give each to a department or the 1st AD, or fix it yourself, and see what follows: the fix, a continuity error, a burn.

concept.hr: Pripravnik sve popravi sam: 12 min sada, 300 min kasnije, dvije ozljede
concept.en: The trainee fixes it all: 12 min now, 300 min later, two injuries

concept.hr: Svaki problem odjelu kojemu pripada: 36 min, ništa pokvareno
concept.en: Each problem to the department that owns it: 36 min, nothing broken

concept.hr: Odjel pogođen po izgledu: šest proslijeđeno, nitko ništa ne dira, 54 min
concept.en: Departments guessed from the look: six passed on, nothing touched, 54 min
